Tamil Nadu MLA Accused of Sending Obscene Messages to Woman Collector

An FIR has been filed against C. Arul Vignesh, a TVK MLA in Tamil Nadu, for allegedly sending obscene messages to a woman IAS officer who serves as the District Collector of Kallakurichi. The complaint was lodged by the Collector, J.E. Padmaja, and the FIR was registered based on this complaint. The matter was brought before the Madras High Court, where a public prosecutor informed a bench that the FIR had been filed. Reports also mention a POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) complaint filed by the woman IAS officer. Some coverage also notes allegations of the MLA demanding a bribe of five crore rupees.
